Almost every mutation here is a constant, because that is what this dispatch is -- the arms hold no arithmetic. why: 0x62b45 reloads +0x3596 into %cx before rejoining the tail.  Nothing between the dispatch and there writes that halfword -- no arm of table 2 does, and finding 285's sweep names the eight functions in the object that write any of the three -- so the reload cannot change the value and modelling it or not is the same function. label: txstate held zero-extended rather than sign-extended
why: The object spells the state two ways -- `cmp $0x4a,%cx` zero-extended at 0x62a70 and `movswl %cx,%eax` sign-extended at 0x62ac5 -- and one `short` models both.  Every test the two spellings feed is equality against a small positive constant, which agrees for all 65,536 halfwords; the one inequality, `> 0x53` at 0x62acd, only decides whether to test equality with 0x54, which is false either way.  So this is equivalent over the WHOLE range and not merely over the 0..86 the diagnostics allow.  Held fixed: nothing.
